title: musa peekelii subsp. angustigemma
intro: Musa peekelii subsp. angustigemma, commonly known as the Angustigemma banana, is a plant species in the family Musaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include relief from fever, inflammation, and pain. The therapeutic actions of Musa peekelii subsp. angustigemma are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions.
